name: anofox-statistics
description: SQL-native statistical regression and inference skills for the anofox_statistics DuckDB extension — regression (OLS/robust/GLM/AFT/mixed-effects, paths and CV, predictions with standard errors), hypothesis, post-hoc, time-series, survival tests and classifier evaluation, diagnostics (influence, residuals, autocorrelation, heteroskedasticity, VIF), AI-ready batch per-group model fitting, and plot-ready long tables for anofox-visualization.
